description:
Location: Eastern Europe 
Function: Engineering / Cloud Platform 
Reports To: Sr. Director, Cloud Platform 


Are you... 

  • Passionate about architecting large-scale cloud platforms?  
  • Excited to define technology that powers an entire portfolio of products, not just a single application?  
  • Interested in building the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform?  

If so, we'd love to meet you. 


Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 


Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 


About the Role 

As a Senior Cloud Architect, you will help define the technical foundation of Esko's next-generation cloud platform. 


You will shape the architecture of a modern, multi-tenant platform that powers products and shared capabilities across Esko's portfolio. This is a hands-on architecture role: you will set technical direction while also building critical platform components and reference implementations that turn architectural decisions into production-ready solutions. 


You will work across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations to evolve our distributed systems, data architecture, and cloud platform for the next stage of growth. 


What You Will Do 

  • Define cloud and platform architecture for a secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant platform supporting multiple products and thousands of customers. 
  • Design distributed systems and establish patterns for service boundaries, event-driven interactions, consistency, resiliency, performance, scalability, and failure recovery. 
  • Shape data architecture and modeling across relational, NoSQL, graph, and distributed data systems, defining how data is modeled, governed, distributed, and accessed across products. 
  • Develop knowledge and semantic architecture, including knowledge graphs, ontologies, domain models, entity relationships, and semantic models that connect information across domains and enable AI-powered experiences. 
  • Build critical platform capabilities. Spend up to 50% of your time hands-on, developing foundational components, critical software modules, prototypes, and reference implementations. 
  • Establish architecture standards and guide technical decisions across software, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and platform engineering. 
  • Drive platform evolution, partnering with Product and Engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture decisions and long-term technology investments. 

Required Experience 

  • 15+ years of experience designing and building enterprise software, SaaS products, or large-scale cloud platforms. 
  • Strong software engineering background with recent hands-on experience building production software and platform components. 
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, including microservices, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency, consistency models, fault tolerance, and distributed system design patterns. 
  • Strong expertise in data architecture and data modeling across relational, NoSQL, graph, and distributed data technologies. 
  • Experience designing knowledge graphs, semantic models, ontologies, or graph-based architectures for complex domains. 
  • Deep experience designing and operating multi-tenant, cloud-native platforms on AWS. 
  • Experience with platform APIs, Kubernetes/EKS, containers, Infrastructure as Code, and modern DevSecOps practices. 
  • Experience with technologies such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, graph databases, and other cloud-native data stores. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns. 
  • Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, and executives. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience designing data or platform capabilities supporting AI-enabled products, agents, or intelligent applications. 
  • Experience leading significant cloud modernization or platform transformation initiatives. 
  • AWS Professional-level certification. 
  • Experience with complex product/data domains, particularly consumer goods, life sciences, manufacturing, or other regulated industries 

What Does Success Look Like 

In this role, success means: 

  • Teams have clear patterns for building distributed services and managing data across product and domain boundaries. 
  • Esko establishes a strong semantic and knowledge architecture that enables data to be connected and used effectively by AI-powered products and agents. 
  • Product teams can build and evolve cloud capabilities faster and with less architectural complexity, while maintaining security, reliability, and scalability. 
  • Critical architectural decisions are translated into working software and reusable platform patterns, not just documentation. 
  • You become a trusted technical partner who can move effectively between architecture, code, and business strategy. 

 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.  Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.
